preconditions.description: The number of rows in the matrix is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of columns in the matrix is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 0 <= a[i][j] <= 1023 for all 1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= m
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix is a non-negative integer less than or equal to 1023.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NIE' or (output == 'TAK' and 1 <= c[i] <= m for all 1 <= i <= n)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NIE' if no solution exists, or 'TAK' followed by a sequence of integers c[1], c[2], ..., c[n] where each c[i] is a valid column index in the matrix.
If the output is 'TAK', then the bitwise XOR of the selected elements from each row is strictly greater than zero.
